caption: The drawing features a central cluster of various flowers and leaves with curling green stems, green leaves, and blossoms in shades of pink, red, yellow, and blue. To the left of the central floral grouping is a bird drawn in light blue with detailed wing and body markings, standing on the ground. On the right side, there is another bird, this one colored in yellow, green, and blue, perched above a small branch or flower. Below the central floral arrangement is a brown horse figure standing on a short green patch of grass. The entire composition is rendered on a plain, light beige background, with each object separated from the others and no overlapping, giving a clear view of each element.
title: Embroidery
